key_insight: The paper trains an attention graph neural network directly from finite-volume residuals, enabling label-free prediction of coupled thermo-fluid fields without CFD-generated training data.
engineering_relevance: This offers a lower-cost surrogate modeling workflow for 3D thermo-fluid simulations, reducing both solver data generation and storage burden while preserving physical fidelity.
method: Build an attention graph neural network on the simulation mesh.
Train by minimizing finite-volume method residuals of the governing equations instead of labeled targets.
Evaluate against CFD references and a data-supervised baseline on steady and transient cases.
evidence_signal: Across four scenarios, the FVM-loss model reaches 2.3–2.8% all-field nRMSE on the steady benchmarks and outperforms the supervised baseline on the parametric transient cases.
watch_item: Residual-based training may depend on mesh quality, equation formulation, and stable optimization, so performance can vary when extending to new geometries or flow regimes.
paper_title: Label-Free Finite-Volume-Residual Training of Attention Graph Neural Networks for Coupled Thermo-Fluid Fields
